meta.title: Reassign Line Item: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and inspect or attempt Reassign Line Item
Sign in as a Procurement Manager in the same tenant and verify Reassign Line Item is available
Compare the two role outcomes and record whether RBAC deliberately grants access to additional roles
Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and inspect or attempt Reassign Line Item; Sign in as a Procurement Manager in the same tenant and verify Reassign Line Item is available; Compare the two role outcomes and record whether RBAC deliberately grants access to additional roles; Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan

args.need: sign in as the non-Procurement Manager user and the Procurement Manager in the same Growth tenant, attempt Reassign Line Item on a PR line item for both roles, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch user roles or operate the Reassign Line Item action, so tester intervention is required for the role-based comparison.
Assert the final screen has no crash or server error after the tester's role-based checks.
